body:
SHANKPIT 636edc0 / IDUNA / PARENA: per-gun Half-Life-style wall decals authored as PARENA gentextures, stored in the NOCK texture DB (ids 27-30), fetched by the client with embedded fallback, multiply-blended on wall hits (shotgun = 8 pellets). PARENA png.prn gained paletted-PNG decode (+ first test-png). IDUNA gained public by-name texture image route (needs redeploy). Live-verified under Xvfb: four visibly different holes. test-bullet-hole, test-png, go tests pass.

⚓ ☃
title: Per-gun bullet-hole decals shipped
